name: io.github.tonyyang0504/marktplaats-mcp
description: Marktplaats (automotive): search_listings, get_listing. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MARKTPLAATS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client id assigned by Marktplaats (API clients are registered by the platform for business/advertiser use); grant_type=client_credentials at https://auth.marktplaats.nl/accounts/oauth/token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MARKTPLAATS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret assigned with it. A client token reaches public resources (categories, search, advertisements) only.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MARKTPLAATS_CATEGORY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Category id to restrict searches to (e.g. the cars category id from GET /v1/categories); without it `query` is mandatory.
